STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad. C.3 SCOPE The contractor shall provide the Library with new perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses and technical support for perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses—new or legacy— in its possession. This support includes the services needed to operate and maintain NLS’s My Talking Books (an Amazon Alexa skill) in production. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. Ostjal on õigus leping üles öelda või sellest taganeda muu hulgas juhul kui müüja rikub korruptsioonivastaseid õigusakte või RHAD-is ettenähtud korruptsioonivastaseid meetmeid, kui sellised meetmed on RHAD-is ette nähtud. Nimetatud olukorra realiseerumisel võib ostja lepingu erakorraliselt ilma ette teatamata üles öelda. Konfidentsiaalsus Infot, mis lepingupooled lepingu täitmise käigus teiselt lepingupoolelt saavad, sh andmed teise lepingupoole kohta, ei kuulu avaldamisele kolmandatele isikutele ilma teise lepingupoole eelneva kirjaliku nõusolekuta, v.a kui see on õigusaktide kohaselt lepingupoolele kohustuslik (edaspidi konfidentsiaalsuskohustus). Müüja vastutab kõigi oma töötajate, alltöövõtjate ja koostööpartnerite poolse konfidentsiaalsuskohustuse täitmise eest. Lepingus mõistavad lepingupooled konfidentsiaalsete andmete all muu hulgas, kuid mitte ainult: mistahes andmeid ostja ja/või temaga võrgustunud haiglate (SA Läänemaa Haigla, SA Raplamaa Haigla ning SA Hiiumaa Haigla, edaspidi tütarhaiglad) patsientide kohta (sh patsientide isikuandmeid ja eriliiki isikuandmeid – s.o andmeid nende terviseseisundi, neile osu

tide isikuandmeid ja eriliiki isikuandmeid – s.o andmeid nende terviseseisundi, neile osutatud või vajalike teenuste jmt kohta); ostja ja/või tema tütarhaiglate töötajate isikuandmeid ja andmeid nende töötasu kohta; andmeid ostja ja/või tema tütarhaiglate struktuuriüksuste kulude, tulude, kasumi ja eelarve kohta; ostja ja/või tema tütarhaiglate infosüsteemides olevat informatsiooni ja/või andmeid ja/või dokumente; muid andmeid, mis ei ole mõeldud avalikuks kasutamiseks ning mille avalikustamine kahjustab või võib ostja ja/või tema tütarhaiglate huve kahjustada. Konfidentsiaalse informatsiooni väljastamisel ja/või juurdepääsu võimaldamisel kolmandatele isikutele eelistatakse informatsiooni andmist väljavõttena.
